title.zh-CN: 双腿皮疹、腹痛与便血迅速加重
title.en: Rapid worsening of leg rash, abdominal pain and bloody stool

summary.zh-CN: 男孩非褪色皮疹伴明显消化道出血，最初腹部影像未定位，病程中出现新的腹部和神经危险信号。
summary.en: A boy has non-blanching rash and gastrointestinal bleeding with initially unrevealing abdominal imaging and later abdominal/neurological red flags.

provenance.citation: 孙兴珍, 田向阳, 舒思静. 过敏性紫癜合并肠套叠、脑出血一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(11):875-876. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.11.020.

en: Deterioration after eight hours and later

text.zh-CN: 腹痛加剧、六次鲜血便，血压140/107 mmHg并抽搐；新腹部包块，超声肠套叠11.7×5 cm。术后血尿、24小时尿蛋白5.21 g；后出现左侧无力，MRI右顶枕出血约20 mL。
text.en: Pain worsened with six bloody stools, blood pressure 140/107 mmHg and a seizure; a new mass corresponded to an 11.7×5 cm intussusception. Postoperatively haematuria and 24-hour protein 5.21 g appeared; later left weakness accompanied an approximately 20 mL right parieto-occipital haemorrhage on MRI.

text.zh-CN: 空气灌肠失败后手术复位，后经综合治疗血压及神经体征恢复、出血吸收。肾活检报告紫癜性肾炎Ⅱ级，之后有间歇蛋白尿，末次随访近两个月尿检正常。
text.en: Air-enema reduction failed and surgery followed. Combined care accompanied recovery of blood pressure and neurological signs with haemorrhage resolution. Biopsy reported grade II purpuric nephritis; intermittent proteinuria later resolved for the two months preceding last follow-up.

prompt.zh-CN: 初诊皮疹和出血最支持什么评估方向？
prompt.en: Which direction is supported by initial rash and bleeding?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: IgA血管炎样多系统表现伴严重失血，需要持续腹部和肾脏监测
text.en: An IgA-vasculitis-like multisystem pattern with severe blood loss requiring ongoing abdominal/renal assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 正常血小板与可触及紫癜相容，但不能忽略出血严重度。
feedback.en: Normal platelets fit palpable purpura but do not reduce bleeding severity.

text.zh-CN: 所有紫癜都由血小板减少解释
text.en: All purpura is explained by thrombocytopenia

text.zh-CN: 旧超声正常保证以后不会肠套叠
text.en: A normal old ultrasound guarantees no later intussusception

feedback.zh-CN: 病情可演变，持续重评估必要。
feedback.en: Disease evolves and repeated assessment is necessary.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 新包块和局灶神经表现分别有肠套叠与脑出血证据，需要并行急症处理
text.en: The new mass and focal signs have evidence of intussusception and cerebral bleeding requiring parallel emergency care

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把新急症统称为原疾病普通腹痛或发作。
feedback.en: New emergencies cannot be dismissed as ordinary pain or an episode of the original illness.

text.zh-CN: 抽搐停止就排除颅内出血
text.en: Seizure cessation excludes intracranial bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 后续局灶无力与MRI已证实出血。
feedback.en: Later focal weakness and MRI establish bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 此前肾功能正常排除后续肾炎
text.en: Earlier normal renal function excludes later nephritis

feedback.zh-CN: 血尿蛋白尿可出现而肌酐未必升高。
feedback.en: Haematuria/proteinuria may emerge without raised creatinine.

prompt.zh-CN: 安全优先级应怎样安排？
prompt.en: How should safety priorities be arranged?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 小儿外科与重症神经肾科并行评估急腹症、颅内出血及高血压
text.en: Coordinate paediatric surgery, critical neurology and renal teams for acute abdomen, intracranial bleeding and hypertension

feedback.zh-CN: 神经局灶征和高颅压风险应先影像评估，不能机械套用腰穿建议。
feedback.en: Focal signs and raised-pressure risk require imaging assessment rather than routine lumbar puncture.

text.zh-CN: 不评估高颅压就照旧文建议立即腰穿
text.en: Perform immediate lumbar puncture without assessing intracranial pressure risk

feedback.zh-CN: 颅内出血和高压背景使此方案危险。
feedback.en: Intracranial bleeding and pressure risk make this unsafe.

text.zh-CN: 只加激素等待包块自行消失
text.en: Give more steroids and wait for the mass to resolve

feedback.zh-CN: 肠套叠需要及时外科/影像干预判断。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明正常旧检查不覆盖新病程。；承认缺少完整现代IgA病理分型、脑出血机制和长期肾风险。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that An old normal study does not cover evolving disease.; acknowledge Complete modern IgA pathology classification, haemorrhage mechanism and long-term renal risk are missing. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告为IgA血管炎样疾病合并肠套叠、肾炎、高血压和脑出血。
conclusion.en: The report described an IgA-vasculitis-like illness with intussusception, nephritis, hypertension and cerebral haemorrhage.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 正常旧检查不覆盖新病程。
keyReasoning.en: An old normal study does not cover evolving disease.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 多系统并发症必须分别识别。
治疗后好转不证明某一药物独立作用。
keyReasoning.en: Recovery after combined care does not prove one drug’s effect.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 旧“过敏性紫癜”术语需现代解释。
teachingPoints.en: Interpret the historical purpura terminology in modern context.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 保留高血压与脑出血因果不确定性。
teachingPoints.en: Retain uncertainty in the hypertension–haemorrhage causal relationship.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不将雷公藤等旧疗法作为当前默认。
teachingPoints.en: Do not make historical Tripterygium treatment a current default.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少完整现代IgA病理分型、脑出血机制和长期肾风险。
unknowns.en: Complete modern IgA pathology classification, haemorrhage mechanism and long-term renal risk are missing.
